subject: a small, strong African American woman of the mid-1800s with a calm, determined face, wearing a plain long dark wool dress, a shawl and a cloth head wrap

panels.01-eastern-shore: the flat Eastern Shore of Maryland around 1822 at dawn, wide tidal marshes and creeks, tall reeds, wheat fields, a few small wooden cabins at the edge of a forest, herons in the mist, quiet wide establishing shot, early 19th century
panels.02-north-star: {S} walking alone through a dark pine forest at night, looking up through the branches at the bright North Star, moonlight on her face, a small cloth bundle in her hand, courage and resolve, 1849
panels.03-same-person: {S} standing at the edge of a field at sunrise, looking down at her open hands in wonder, golden light pouring through the trees and over the fields, a feeling of freedom and awe, Pennsylvania 1849
panels.04-conductor: {S} leading a small group of men, women and children quietly along a marsh path on a cold winter night, she walks in front with one hand raised to signal silence, the others following close together wrapped in shawls and coats, stars overhead, mid-1800s Maryland, protective guidance
panels.05-parents: {S} guiding her elderly mother and father in a simple horse-drawn farm wagon along a moonlit country road at night, the old couple wrapped in blankets, her hand on the horse's bridle, tender and watchful, 1857
panels.06-combahee: {S} standing at the rail of a Union Army side-wheel steamboat on the Combahee River at dawn in 1863, pointing the way upriver to a uniformed officer, Black Union soldiers of a South Carolina regiment helping families with baskets and bundles into rowboats from the riverbank, joyful faces, palmetto trees and rice fields, leadership and liberation, no fighting
panels.07-auburn: {S} in her late forties standing proudly at the gate of her wooden farmhouse in Auburn, New York, around 1869, apple trees, a vegetable garden, chickens, family members and boarders on the porch, warm autumn light, peaceful home
panels.08-home: an elderly {S}, white-haired and leaning on a cane, seated as guest of honor on the porch of a large white farmhouse in 1908 at the opening of a home for aged people, a crowd of well-dressed community members and church leaders gathered on the lawn, American flags and bunting, dignity and celebration
